blocks.content:
Dashboards in Grafana are made of panels. Each panel displays one view of your data, and you arrange panels together to build a complete picture of your systems, applications, or business metrics.

Without panels, a dashboard is empty. Learning how to add a panel, connect it to a data source, and write a query is the first step to building useful dashboards that help you monitor and understand your data.
In the next milestone, you add a panel to a dashboard.
